0x000832.en: 「Th-this is as far as I go...!」

0x000864.en: 「With my skills now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x00095D.en: 「Damn it!@　Next time you won't get me!」

0x0009D7.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000ABE.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000B32.en: 「Nngh, is this as far as I go!?」

0x000BC2.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　This isn't fun...」

0x000C16.en: 「I blew it...!@　Nothing to do but eject...」

0x000C8A.en: 「Guh! No choice but to fall back!!」

0x000D00.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000D67.en: 「This is it for me... the rest is yours.」

0x000D99.en: 「Dammit...!@　Is this as far as I go!?」

0x000E13.en: 「No good, took too much... I'm retreating!」

0x000E60.en: 「Well, I'm beat. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E9E.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000EE5.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F90.en: 「Ngh... So I'm the one who falls... I'm ejecting!」

0x0010CC.en: 「Ngh...! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x001139.en: 「Damn it! All hands, abandon ship, now!!」

0x001180.en: 「Sorry... I'm leaving the rest to you.」

0x0011B5.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x001272.en: 「Ngh... You're as good as they say.」

0x0012A1.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still not ready...!」

0x0012EF.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x0013AA.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x0013D9.en: 「N-No good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001417.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x001446.en: 「I can't do any more. If you'll excuse me.」

0x0014D1.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll have to withdraw here...!」

0x001637.en: 「Bailing out...@ Ngh...! Not my finest moment...」

0x0019B5.en: 「Lord Alteur, congratulations on your@ appointment as Special Deputy Vice President.」

0x001A27.en: 「That said, in the line of presidential succession@ I still rank several places below Vice President Dan Hendricks.」

0x001AA4.en: 「Even so, it's an exceptional promotion.@ Proof that President Grusman values the 'GS'@ and has high hopes for their work.」

0x001B6E.en: 「The Re-Tech units were dispatched to@ the Izu Special Tech Instructor Corps, as ordered.」

0x001BD9.en: 「The pilot is Professor Radcliff's son, correct?@ He doesn't know our will is behind@ any of this, does he?」

0x001C78.en: 「The professor has been sworn to silence.@ And I've told Kenneth to keep the details@ from the Instructor Corps as well.」

0x001D19.en: 「Good.@ Let's hope it yields useful data.@ ...Anything else?」

0x001D82.en: 「'Grey' has made contact.@ Their advance party has arrived and begun their survey...@ X-Day within a week, they say.」

0x001E1E.en: 「Hmm... just as I predicted. Their target?」

0x001E52.en: 「Our head and arm... and the Ill Omen.」

0x001E8C.en: 「Heh, still fixated on that.@ Or is it because the Granzon remains missing?」

0x001F03.en: 「The Ill Omen is undergoing an overhaul@ at the Orleans factory, it seems.」

0x001F5F.en: 「Then transfer every unit here. Notify Mao@ Industry, by my authority as Special Deputy VP...@ have the Federation Army handle it.」

0x002028.en: 「Just in case, I'll dispatch Omega as well.@ 'Grey' is another man tied to the Ill Omen...@ he may be trying to outmaneuver us.」

0x0020D3.en: 「You mean he... no, the other one@ knows where the Ill Omen is?」

0x0021A3.en: 「As arranged.@ Also, send word to Marshal Gaspard Gillan@ of the Federation Army.」

0x00221B.en: 「So we're striking Paris from the list of targets?」

0x002258.en: 「Yes. I'll go there myself, with Alpha,@ aboard the Air Christmas.」

0x0022B7.en: 「And if Marshal Gaspard doesn't believe@ 'Grey's' warning?」

0x002313.en: 「Then he simply loses his head... but no.@ He's the man who turned a blind eye to Mission Halper@ to preserve the system... he's no fool.」

0x0023BE.en: 「Gaspard will act, without fail.@ Though sadly, the Steel Dragon Squadron that would@ spearhead it has gone missing...」

0x00244B.en: 「But thanks to that, the 'GS' can make@ a sensational debut.」

0x0024F6.en: Earth Federation Army Far East Corps, Izu Base

0x00253D.en: 「...An escort mission for the@ Huckebein series transport, sir?」

0x0025A6.en: 「Correct. At 0600 tomorrow you'll depart Izu@ for Mao Industry's Orleans factory.」

0x002642.en: 「The transport's destination is Hickam Base in Hawaii.」

0x002688.en: 「Why us, and not a unit from the@ Southern Europe Corps?」

0x0026DE.en: 「Mao went out of their way to request you Instructor Corps@ by name. The Aviano lot took it at face value@ and dumped the whole thing on me.」

0x00279E.en: 「Since the Huckebein's involved,@ they figured it'd be a headache...」

0x002809.en: 「...Understood.@ The Special Tech Instructor Corps will@ commence the mission at 0600 tomorrow.」

0x002878.en: 「Your charges are those cursed Vanishing Troopers.@ I don't need any new legends. It'd reflect on my honor.」

0x002923.en: 「And there's Ensign Aqua Centrum,@ seconded from the Zentr Project...」

0x0029E7.en: 「...I've no intention of giving her special treatment.@ Or did the Zentr Project make@ some kind of request?」

0x002A8F.en: 「If so, there's quite a lot@ I'd like to ask them myself.」

0x002AEE.en: 「Anything involving the Zentr Project comes@ straight from the President's Special Aide.@ I don't know the details either.」

0x002B97.en: 「Ensign Aqua's father.@ He contacted me directly.」

0x002BF3.en: (I see... so that's how it is.)

0x002C44.en: 「...Aqua, won't you reconsider, just once more?」

0x002C87.en: 「You're bringing this up again?@ I finally became a pilot.@ I have no intention of going home.」

0x002D05.en: 「Your uncle worries too.@ A woman as a soldier... if anything happened to you,@ what would you do then?」

0x002DA1.en: 「That man only cares about protecting his own turf.@ I'll say it again - I don't want to inherit the company,@ or become a politician.」

0x002E52.en: 「Aqua, just what is it you're unhappy about...」

0x002E86.en: 「Like I said, I can't stand people who try to tie me down.@ No matter what you say, I won't change my mind.」

0x002F09.en: 「Ungh, you get your stubbornness from Amalia...」

0x002F49.en: 「If Mother were alive, I know she'd support me.」

0x002F8F.en: 「Th-That can't be true.@ What parent wouldn't worry with their child taken into the army...」

0x00300A.en: 「That Special Tech Instructor Corps you're with@ has deep ties to that Steel Dragon Squadron.@ One wrong step and you could end up on the front lines...」

0x0030B5.en: 「Father, it's time for work now.@ And stop calling the base directly.」

0x00311D.en: 「A call from a Federation Senate senator@ caused quite a stir here, you know.」

0x003194.en: 「No, I only asked the base commander@ to see that you're treated well...」

0x003214.en: 「Y-You did what!?@ I c-can't believe it! That's overprotective even for you!」

0x0032ED.en: 「Haah... I already stand out enough as it is@ because of the DFC suit...@ and now Father goes and does this... haah...」

0x003418.en: 「Arado, we're not going to play around.」

0x00344F.en: 「But France means croissants, baguettes,@ batards... ungh, I can't wait to eat!」

0x0034E2.en: 「Those... are all just bread, aren't they?」

0x003513.en: 「So, what are we doing in France?」

0x003541.en: 「Take delivery of every Huckebein unit at@ Mao's Orleans factory, and escort them@ all the way to Hickam.」

0x0035D4.en: 「Why would they send the Huckebein somewhere like that...?」

0x003614.en: 「I wasn't told the reason either.@ We leave at 0600 tomorrow. Everyone, get ready.」

0x00367F.en: 「Um, Major...@ I take it we're going too, then?」

0x0036DE.en: 「Yeah. I've no intention of treating you special.」

0x003740.en: 「But try to understand your father's feelings a little.@ I'm a father myself... I can't dismiss it as none of my business.」

0x0037DF.en: 「Um...@ Aqua, did something happen with your father?」

0x003900.en: 「Yes, I came down from the moon three days ago.」

0x00393D.en: 「...About the Steel Dragon Squadron, still no word of them...?」

0x003986.en: 「Please don't trouble yourself.@ Rio... my daughter, I'm sure she's safe and well.」

0x0039EE.en: 「Wherever she is, she'll be with@ dependable comrades...」

0x003AB3.en: 「I revised the railgun's center of gravity@ in Flyer Mode. It was a little unsteady,@ so...」

0x003B43.en: 「I see. I'll look over the data later, then.」

0x003B9C.en: 「Dr. Hamill, Dr. Omiya,@ are the Huckebeins ready?」

0x003BFC.en: 「008L, Mk-II, Mk-III...@ every unit's ready to load onto the transport.」

0x003C67.en: 「Though we'll be keeping the EX here at this factory.」

0x003CB0.en: 「The EX... you managed to gather the parts?」

0x003CE7.en: 「Right. Officially, that's not a Huckebein but the@ Exbein, an in-house data-gathering unit...@ There's no need to submit it this time.」

0x003DCF.en: 「Short for 'Extra Huckebein.'@　A convenient little cover story.」

0x003E2E.en: 「More to the point, why are the Huckebein@　series being moved to Hickam?」

0x003EA2.en: 「What? You weren't told the reason either?」

0x003EE2.en: 「No... Only that it's on orders from@　Special Vice President Steinbeck.」

0x003F38.en: 「Him... one of the core members of 'GS,' if I recall.」

0x003F84.en: 「Something felt off, so I offered the Instructor Corps@ as escort... but if even you're in the dark, Major,@ this stinks.」

0x004093.en: 「If so, then Hickam's just a waypoint...?@　But then why was the escort order handed down@　to us, the Instructor Corps?」

0x00412C.en: 「True enough...@　If they wanted to keep us out of it, they could've@　just buried our request.」

0x0041AD.en: （Maybe I should contact Gilliam and have him dig...）

0x0041ED.en: 「A Mao factory really is huge...@　Nothing like the Mother Base back in the Antarctic.」

0x004261.en: 「That's because this place isn't built for mass production.」

0x0042A7.en: 「But there were tons of assembly lines,@　and hardly any machines on them.」

0x004312.en: （With times like these, orders for Personal Troopers@　should be pouring in... Are they in the red?）

0x0043DC.en: 「Major Kai, unidentified units are closing in.」

0x00441F.en: 「Now, of all times... Are they after the Huckebein?」

0x004496.en: 「Instructor Corps, Hugo, Aqua, launch now!@　Move!」

0x00451A.en: 「Eleve 1 to all units. Prepare to intercept.」

0x00454B.en: 「Um, wouldn't it be better to get the Huckebein@　moving and pull them into the hangar, or load@　them onto a transport...?」

0x0045DE.en: 「They're all in standby mode, so we can't@　bring them online right away.」

0x004646.en: 「Exactly. We'll haul the Huckebein back to@　the hangar by carrier.@　Buy us the time to do it.」

0x004727.en: 「More hands are better than fewer, right?@　Besides, my sister's in that factory.@　I can't let them break through.」

0x0047E2.en: 「Joshua, this time the enemy's got pilots@　in those machines.@　Can you handle it?」

0x004851.en: 「The Antarctic ruins were hit by more than just the@　Einst... This won't be my first fight against manned foes.」

0x004917.en: 「Hmph, saves me the trouble of a warning.@　All units, the enemy's Armored Modules, but@　there's a lot of them. Don't let any slip past.」

0x0049BD.en: 「Joshua, you're rear guard.@　Protect Lim and the others.」

0x004A11.en: 「Hugo, you're feeling all right, aren't you?」

0x004A48.en: 「Yeah. You just manage your output properly.@　A power-down at the wrong moment could get us killed.」

0x004AD1.en: 「You don't have to tell me. I'll show you!」

0x004B0B.en: 「You're the ones who struck first...@　Fight, or be killed...!」

0x004B76.en: 「That goes both ways, and you know it!」

0x004BB6.en: 「If they wanted destruction, they'd hit the factory@ or shoot down a transport in transit. No, they're@ after capturing them...!」

0x004C55.en: （This resistance, no wavering at all...@　Could the enemy pilots be...?）

0x004CB1.en: 「Their showing up here was no accident.@　How did they learn about this operation...?」

0x004D25.en: 「Mm...!@　Unnaturally little hesitation in their movements.@　It can't be...」

0x004DC8.en: 「! This uneasy feeling, I know it...!」

0x004E58.en: 「...You'll understand when this is over.@　Focus on the DFC!」

0x004EAE.en: 「...That's the last of them, for now.@　All units, spread out and watch the factory perimeter.」

0x004F10.en: 「...Were those enemies remnants of the <Neue DC>?」

0x004F5B.en: 「Probably... They never hit the factory, so@　the target really was the Huckebein...」

0x005008.en: 「Odds are, they aren't Neue DC remnants.」

0x00505E.en: 「Lamia. You thought so too, didn't you?」

0x005125.en: 「Huh? Huh? What do you mean?@　Joshua, did you feel something too?」

0x00518A.en: 「Not really...@　Just that their movements seemed off somehow.@　I can't explain it well, but...」

0x005214.en: （So he sensed it too. Sharp instincts.）

0x00524E.en: 「Off, huh... Now that you say it,@　maybe I felt that, maybe I didn't...」

0x0052C5.en: 「We'll know once we examine the wreckage.@　Though there may be no evidence left...」

0x00533C.en: 「And that itself would be evidence, right?」

0x005413.en: 「Teleporting in! I knew it, it's them!」

0x005484.en: 「Th-that position, the Huckebein are right there!!」

0x0054C4.en: 「So they'll blow their cover just to@　get their hands on the Huckebein!」

0x005545.en: 「Tch...!@　If I fire carelessly, I'll hit the Huckebein!」

0x005595.en: 「But they can't re-teleport right away!@　This is our chance to take them back...」

0x005669.en: 「Major, an object closing on us fast!」

0x005742.en: 「No <IFF> response, no machine data on record...」

0x005787.en: 「Director Yuan, do you recognize that unit?」

0x0057BE.en: 「N-no! We've never built anything like that!」

0x0057F8.en: 「It doesn't look like a mere copy... if anything...」

0x005835.en: 「It shot down a Guarlion, so does that@　mean it's on our side?」

0x0058E4.en: 「...If they're targeted and about to be seized,@　the units may be destroyed...」

0x0059BE.en: 「Grr! All units, attack the unknown!@　But don't drop it on the factory!」

0x005A29.en: 「There should... still be more inside there.」

0x005AF1.en: 「Destroying the Huckebein series...@　That was it...!」

0x005B47.en: 「My apologies, Director.@　That it came to this...」

0x005BA9.en: 「No... We should count ourselves lucky@　that not one of our people was killed...」

0x005C14.en: 「And besides, the Huckebein@　haven't all been lost.」

0x005C73.en: 「True enough.@　We still have the mass-production Huckebein Mk-II...@　and the third prototype should be...」

0x005D00.en: 「On top of those, we still have the Exbein.」

0x005D74.en: 「Yes... It took damage, but the@　frame itself isn't broken.」

0x005DDF.en: 「We're not giving up. For the Steel Dragon Squadron,@　we'll gather the remaining parts and finish the Exbein.」

0x005E62.en: 「We'd already begun the work,@　meaning to give it a major overhaul in the first place.」

0x005ECD.en: 「For now all we can do is patch it up and@　make do, but in time...」

0x005F32.en: 「Then I leave the work to you.@　The situation we feared is all but certain now.」

0x005FE7.en: 「Still, what in the world was that black machine...」

0x00602A.en: 「I believe it was built using diverted@　Huckebein series data, but...」

0x0060AD.en: 「It's no mere copy. It seems to match the Mk-III...@　or even surpass it in performance.」

0x006136.en: 「What's more, it ripped the black hole engine@　and <Tronium> engine cores@　right out of the Huckebein.」

0x006248.en: 「It doesn't seem to be one of their number, but...」

0x006282.en: 「No... The ones who appeared first weren't out@　to destroy the Huckebein, but to seize them.」

0x006305.en: 「If that isn't a Mao Industry machine...@　then where was it built?」

0x006382.en: 「A group with mass-prod Huckebein Mk-II data, capable@ of building a machine like that...@ <Isurugi Heavy Industries> comes to mind first.」

0x00643E.en: 「They'd be after the know-how behind the@　black hole engine and the@　Tronium engine, after all.」

0x0064D7.en: 「So all they needed was the heart of it, not@　the machine itself... and that's why they destroyed it?」

0x006563.en: 「Still, it's strange they didn't come after us.@　With that kind of power, clearing the obstacles@　would put everything here within their reach.」

0x006639.en: 「...Major Kai, the analysis results are in.」

0x006692.en: 「Just as we expected.@　The ones piloting the Armored Modules were@　bioroids...」

0x00670A.en: 「They're near identical to the ones the@　<Inspectors> used. And the ESW pattern@　on teleport-in matches too, y'know.」

0x0067D9.en: 「Yes...@　The Inspectors have returned to the Earth sphere.」
